fields.statement: Verifier at 6718a349d: go test -trimpath ./internal/api ./internal/workflow/... -run 'TestReviewCheckRefusesStaleRound|TestPlanFreshStep|TestPlanBuiltin' passes; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/describe-golden passes (golden has the fresh flag); full internal/api, internal/workflow and internal/run packages pass. Read the diff: State.RoundStale (rounds <= rounds at the latest revise entry) gates review-check before judging, with a Conflict naming round N as predating the latest revise and writing nothing; --fresh returns pass after that gate only. The test covers round 2 and round 3 stale for both forms with no asked entry, and a later fresh round passing both. plan.toml and plan-milestone.toml add step fresh (run = rhiza run review-check --fresh, on.pass = check, on.fail = review) and critic on.pass = fresh, checked by TestPlanFreshStep. An extra overlay test (no tree edit) confirmed: no revise -> --fresh passes and check judges round 1 as before; round 2 then revise -> stale refusal naming round 2; round 3 after revise -> --fresh exits 0 with no asked entry and review-check passes the stale gate into the unchanged judging path. Note: the leaf's own test makes its fresh round round 4 with no findings rather than a confirmed round 3.
